verdict.rationale:
Radar's API exposes the building blocks an agent would need — listing/approving reviews (docs-8/21), risk insights and related-payment network context (docs-12/19), and an official MCP server for agent integration (probe-4) — so an agent could plausibly pull flagged cases, gather evidence, and act. However there's no documented feature for automated summarization or an explicit 'recommend, human confirms' workflow; approve/reject are direct actions rather than a recommend-then-confirm pattern.

missing for 10: an explicit AI-summarization/recommendation feature, evidence of a human-confirmation step distinct from direct approve/reject, and any hands-on demonstration of an agent working the queue end-to-end.
